clue.text: Wise to dispatch present, as Solomon was

indicators.note: to dispatch is to send away, so one word is removed from the other here

parts.note: a knowing person is wise and shrewd
the present moment is now

explanation.surface: A remark that wise people should get rid of a gift, as the biblical Solomon did.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to dispatch' takes NOW out of KNOWING, leaving the four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Solomon was the ruler of ancient Israel, a monarch famed for wisdom.

clue.text: I hold catch, as goalies do

definitions.meaning: an angler's net that keeps the caught fish alive in the water speaks for itself
goalkeepers guard, or keep, the net

explanation.definitionFit: An angler's keepnet holds the catch; read as two words it is what a goalkeeper does with the net.

clue.text: Catch champ right at the end in this?

definitions.text: Catch champ right at the end in this?

parts.note: to nail someone is to catch them
to champ is to chew or bite

explanation.surface: A tense match where the champion is only caught at the very end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at the end' places R last. 'champ' looks like a champion, but it is the verb meaning chew.
explanation.definitionFit: A nail-biter is a contest so close it keeps spectators anxious until the finish.

clue.text: Like to see cracking sort of wrestling from the right side

parts.note: as means like, in comparisons
taken as written

indicators.note: one piece cracks another open by getting inside it
read from the right, the letters run backwards

parts.note: all-in is a freestyle kind of wrestling
V is short for vide, Latin for see

explanation.surface: Someone eager to see a wrestling style done properly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the right' turns ALLIN into NILLA, and 'cracking' puts V into it after the N. ASTON VILLA is a Birmingham football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Aston Villa is an English football team, and a team is a side.

clue.text: Rogue priest brought to account by military

indicators.note: rogue as an adjective means wayward, so the letters stray from their order

explanation.surface: A wayward clergyman is called to account by the army.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rogue' rearranges PRIEST.
explanation.definitionFit: A sitrep is a military situation report, an account given by the forces.

clue.text: Do too much about one refusing to fight sanction

parts.note: over can mean about, as in talking a matter over
CO is a conscientious objector
to OK something is to approve or sanction it

explanation.surface: A complaint that a pacifist's approval has been overdone.
explanation.definitionFit: To overcook is to cook too long, and by extension to overdo or exaggerate anything.

clue.text: Mushroom to live on nitrogen in very cold office

indicators.note: in places the run of pieces inside the other letters

parts.note: icy means very cold

indicators.note: in a down answer one piece sits on top of the next

parts.note: a cep is an edible mushroom, the porcino
to reside is to live somewhere
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A fungus living on nitrogen inside a freezing room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts CEPRESIDEN inside V plus ICY, splitting ICY after its I.
explanation.definitionFit: The vice-presidency is the office held by a vice-president.

clue.text: Tiredness stops after I drink

indicators.note: the word is cut off once its letter I is reached, the rest dropped

parts.note: lassitude is weariness or tiredness

explanation.surface: Fatigue sets in once I have had a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stops after I' ends LASSITUDE at its I, dropping TUDE.
explanation.definitionFit: A lassi is an Indian yoghurt-based drink.

clue.text: Chap's taken off hat for speech

indicators.note: taken off means removed, so one word loses some letters

parts.note: a headdress is ornamental headwear, a hat
he stands for a chap or man

explanation.surface: A man removes his hat before giving a speech.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken off' removes HE from HEADDRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: An address is a formal speech delivered to an audience.

clue.text: Sense of optimism's altered, or affected, logo

indicators.note: altered means changed, so these letters take a new order

explanation.surface: A company's optimism is reflected in a changed, pretentious logo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'altered' rearranges OR, AFFECTED and LOGO.
explanation.definitionFit: The feel-good factor is a widespread mood of optimism, especially about the economy.

clue.text: High explosive device discovered in hospital department

indicators.note: discovered in means found inside, so one piece sits within another

parts.note: ENT is ear, nose and throat
a mine is a buried explosive device

explanation.surface: A bomb found in a hospital ward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High' reads as an adjective about the bomb, but it is the definition, in the sense of lofty rank; 'discovered in' is the containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Eminent means high in rank or standing.

clue.text: Having charges cut

definitions.meaning: charged with excise duty, a tax on goods

explanation.definitionFit: Excised can mean subjected to excise tax, and also cut away.

clue.text: With no training expert pair in republic land international trophy

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in places these pieces inside another word

parts.note: Belize is a country in Central America
PE is physical education
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: A country without trained experts somehow lands an international trophy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts PEACEPR inside BELIZE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nobel Peace Prize is a prestigious international award.

clue.text: Do needlework, and other clothwork besides?

parts.note: to tat is to make tatting, a kind of lace
too means besides or as well

explanation.surface: A sewer who does other cloth crafts as well.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the verb: to tattoo is to work with a needle on skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Tattooing is literally decorating skin with a needle, a needlework of sorts.

clue.text: Food goes far when spread round one

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so these letters go round another
spread means scattered, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A dish that stretches a long way when served around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when spread' rearranges GOES FAR, and 'round' puts it around I.
explanation.definitionFit: Foie gras is a luxury food made from fattened goose or duck liver.

clue.text: Rubbish girl's poor performance for United

parts.note: rot means nonsense or rubbish
her means belonging to a girl
ham acting is overdone and poor

explanation.surface: A girl's terrible acting is panned as rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: Rotherham United is an English football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Rotherham United is a football club, so the town name stands for that club.

clue.text: Rat count revised on his appearance? The Tim

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'Rat count revised on his appearance? The Tim', ends in a stray fragment 'The Tim' that fits no parse; no scan, and a search finds no full text
annotationWithheld.clue: Rat count revised on his appearance? The Tim

clue.text: Fields, perhaps, in which Lord's organised riding competition

indicators.note: in which means a piece sits inside the one before

parts.note: W C Fields was an American comedian

indicators.note: organised means arranged, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: Lord's is a London cricket ground, here just the letters of Lord
up means riding, of a jockey on a horse

explanation.surface: Playing fields where Lord's put on a horse-riding contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' yields ORLD, and 'in which' places it inside the comedian's initials. Lord's is a London cricket ground, which steers the surface towards cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: The World Cup is an international sporting competition.

clue.text: Direction to arrest a band of lorry drivers heading north in relay

indicators.note: to arrest is to hold, so one piece holds another

parts.note: west is a compass direction

indicators.note: heading north in a down answer means read upwards, backwards

parts.note: taken as written
CB is citizens' band radio, used by lorry drivers

explanation.surface: Orders for police to detain a gang of truckers driving north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading north' turns the band and the A upwards, giving BCA, and 'to arrest' holds it within the compass point. CB radio was the lorry drivers' medium.
explanation.definitionFit: A webcast is a broadcast relayed over the internet.

clue.text: Judge more qualified to waive fine for slight irregularity

indicators.note: to waive is to give up, so a letter is removed

parts.note: fitter means more suitable or qualified
F is short for fine, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A better-qualified judge lets a fine go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to waive' drops F from FITTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Jitter is a small irregular fluctuation, as in a signal.

clue.text: Snake discovered in old crate

definitions.meaning: a crate is slang for an old car, one that rattles

explanation.definitionFit: A rattler is a rattlesnake, and also an old rattling vehicle.

clue.text: Capture with a blocked-in knight

indicators.note: blocked in means enclosed, so the pieces go inside

parts.note: to gain is to win or capture
taken as written

explanation.surface: A chess move capturing a piece while a knight is hemmed in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blocked-in' puts W and A inside GAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Gawain is a knight of the Round Table in Arthurian legend.

clue.text: Floor one hits after the knock-down?

definitions.text: Floor one hits after the knock-down?

parts.words: Floor one hits after the knock-down?
parts.note: a boxer flattened lands on the floor; read as shopping, a store floor of knock-down prices

explanation.definitionFit: A bargain basement is a store floor selling goods at reduced, knock-down prices.

clue.text: Organ's not supposed to hold note

definitions.note: means relating to an organ, an adjective, here the kidney

indicators.note: to hold means to contain, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: real means actual, not supposed

explanation.surface: An organ that is genuine holds a musical note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to hold' puts N inside REAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Renal means relating to the kidneys, which are organs.

clue.text: Red Indian bit once on wagon wheel

parts.note: an anna was a former Indian coin
on the wagon means teetotal, TT
O is shaped like a wheel

explanation.surface: An old Indian coin on a wagon wheel.
explanation.walkthrough: The anna was a small Indian coin, a sixteenth of a rupee.
explanation.definitionFit: Annatto is an orange-red dye from the achiote tree.

clue.text: Boy unenthusiastic about hot drinks

definitions.note: a plural noun standing for the mass noun, intoxicating drinks

parts.note: Al is a boy's name

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece goes round another

parts.note: cool means lukewarm or unenthusiastic

explanation.surface: A lad who is lukewarm about hot drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts H inside COOL.
explanation.definitionFit: Alcohol is the general term for intoxicating drinks.

clue.text: Wearing shawl, dropping son, viewing figure

indicators.note: dropping means losing, so a letter is removed

parts.note: a stole is a shawl
a TV rating is a viewing figure

explanation.surface: A figure in a shawl, minus her son, watching television.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropping' removes S from STOLE. 'Wearing' is used in the sense of putting up with.
explanation.definitionFit: To wear something can mean to accept or put up with it.

clue.text: Arab returning part of computer cipher

indicators.note: returning means going back, so the letters read backwards

parts.note: RAM is random-access memory
a cipher is zero, O

explanation.surface: An Arab coming back with a piece of computer code.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns RAM plus O into the four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Omar is an Arab given name.
